Count choices of image subspaces (R,S) of dimensions r,s spanning W using Gaussian bins and graph of a map; choose a nu-space U containing W; surjections V/U→R and V/U→S with zero common kernel are counted by subspace Möbius inversion F_q(ell;r,s). The formula vanishes exactly outside max(r,s)<=w<=r+s, w<=nu<=n, max(r,s)<=n−nu<=r+s; a diagonal-plus-complements linear embedding proves sufficiency over any field. Independent exact integer evaluations reproduce n,q totals (2,2):10, (3,2):148, (3,3):1665, (4,2):8296, and strata (42,21,42) at n=3,q=2,r=s=1.
